## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem it Solves
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. Be as detailed as possible.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases
Describe specific use cases where this feature would be beneficial.

## Benefits
- Benefit 1
- Benefit 2
- Benefit 3

## Implementation Considerations
Any thoughts on how this might be implemented? (Optional)

## Mockups/Examples
If applicable, add mockups, diagrams, or examples to help explain your feature.

## Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Important
- [ ] Critical

## Willingness to Contribute
- [ ] I would be willing to implement this feature
- [ ] I would need guidance to implement this
- [ ] I cannot implement this but would like to see it

## Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
